question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Traders price a 95.5% chance that Xi Jinping remains in office through 2026 because his position has been reinforced through successive party congresses, abolition of presidential term limits, and appointment of loyalists to the Politburo and Central Military Commission. Institutional control over succession norms, security apparatus, and information channels has limited visible factional challenges in recent years. Scheduled events such as the next National Congress around 2027 fall outside the resolution window, anchoring the current consensus. A sudden health development, major economic shock, or unanticipated elite realignment could still alter the outcome before the end of 2026, though no such catalysts have materialized in verifiable reporting.
